The '''Tusken language pack''' was a commercial piece of software for [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] which enabled them to acquire the [[Tusken/Legends|Tusken language]],<ref name="CWA" /> the [[Language/Legends|language]] used by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], widely held to be very difficult to master.<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> It was traded during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CWA" /> a major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droids]] were compatible with the program.<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tusken language pack is part of the [[:w:c:cwa:Protocol Droid Part Pack II|Protocol Droid Part Pack II]] for players in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], released in [[2010]]<ref name="Season 3 Premiere Announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_date/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season 3 Premiere Date Announced}}</ref> and shut down on [[March 31]], [[2014]].<ref name="CWAClosure">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=2014-01-24|archivedate=20140127193845}}</ref> The language pack, along with [[heavy blaster arm]]s, could be bought for 300 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]].<ref name="CWA" />
